decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal fails to comply with the terms of Article 4 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (Amendment) (England) Order 2013 as amended because the proposal has been completed and therefore the Prior Approval notification does not comply with Class A A.4 (10) of the General Permitted Development Order (England) Order 2015.

Condition : 2 - Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that the use of the property is as a dwellinghouse and therefore the application does not comply with the terms of Part 1, Class A of the General Permitted Development Order (England) Order 2015

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding what is depicted on the plans, the enlargement of the dwellinghouse comprised a part single, part two-storey rear extension and without any evidence to the contrary, was built under one building operation.  As such the submission fails to comply with Class A.1(h) and (i) of Part 1 of the General Permitted Development Order (England) Order 2015
description: Ground floor rear extension 6.0 metres deep, maximum height of 3.530 metres, 2.569 metres high to the eaves
